subject: Arriving today? Check in on the way
body:
Hi Meera,

You're arriving today and haven't checked in online yet. It only takes about two minutes: photograph your ID, sign the registration card, and confirm the card on file for room 412. Nothing is charged, we just check it works.

Here is your link: https://checkin.example.com/MH-3009

See you shortly.

The Hotel Aurora team

This message was prepared with AI assistance and reviewed by our team before it was sent. Reply any time to reach a person directly.
